posts.cooked:
Ok... while Vengence was fun... it got old quick... and the villian team has gone unplayed for the past 2 months.
When can we expect to see another SotM expansion?

I am not looking for a firm date.. but a ballpark would be nice Q4 2014...Q2 2015... Fall 2015...? 


I have some $$$ earmarked for gaming I want to spend or reserve. During the summer I host gaming nights nearly every weekend... and either I want to have something new, or at least reserved for an anticipated purchase of a product in the works...I would be more than happy to plan for the purchase/kickstarter/pre-order...

Any data will be welcome. .. and wanted to give SotM the first look before I start poking around Fanatsy Flight Games, Asmodee, or Days of Wonder... 
 

 

Thanks

posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
Wrath of the Cosmos is still a bit away. Playtesting, as of writing this, has not started for it as we are still working through Tactics related stuff (for which I really hope you got in on the Kickstarter, as that game is going to be a genre buster for sure).

With Tactics looking at a December delivery, I'd be surprised to see another SotM expansion ship to consumers in 2014. However, I certainly do not speak on their behalf, and playtesting SotM stuff nowadays (especially a non-mega expansion) goes very quickly. I am totally up for being surprised though.
